info.title: MET Norway Sunrise 3.0
info.description: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute's free, keyless sunrise/moon service. `moonToday` returns the moon's rise, set, culmination and PHASE ANGLE for a coordinate pair. The `date` parameter is optional: omitted, the service answers for today, which is what lets a producer with static arguments ask about tonight. MET Norway's terms of service require an identifying User-Agent, set on the API entry.

get.summary: Moonrise, moonset, culmination and phase angle for a coordinate pair (defaults to today)
get.description: GeoJSON Feature whose `properties` carry `moonrise.time`, `moonrise.azimuth`, `moonset.time`, `moonset.azimuth`, `high_moon` (culmination time and disc-centre elevation) and `moonphase` — the phase as an ANGLE IN DEGREES, 0 new, 90 first quarter, 180 full, 270 last quarter. Illuminated fraction is (1 - cos(phase))/2, computed by the caller.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: ISO date. OMIT for today — that is the whole point of this operation.
